verdict.rationale: Customer records are keyed by a mandatory, client-supplied unique `userId`, which can be fetched directly via `GET /consumer/user/{userId}` and bulk-loaded through batch endpoints that report `failedRecords`. Together these give a solid reconciliation path for users. Cases can be created and listed with status filters through the Management API, but nothing shows that cases carry a caller-supplied or stable external identifier usable for reconciliation. missing for 10: evidence of external/stable IDs on case records, case lookup by external reference, an explicit reconciliation or idempotency guidance for users and cases, independent corroboration.
